**H1 (model D): SUPPORTED.** Gene-set average (A) meets the same criterion: yes. H1 is therefore a sanity check (the pathway model reproduces a strong, known response in unseen donors), not evidence that the neural model outperforms simple pathway scoring (decision D14).

Largest donor-median response of any shuffled-mask unit (control E), per cell type: B cells 0.59, CD14+ Monocytes 1.37, CD4 T cells 0.39, Dendritic cells 1.34, FCGR3A+ Monocytes 1.29, NK cells 0.52

## H2 - faithfulness is imperfect

Pathways (model D, present in all folds): 47. Share with median attribution purity < 0.5: **70%** (criterion >= 25%). **H2: SUPPORTED.**

Median over pathways, by model (E = gene-identity-shuffled control; its purity/ablation use its OWN shuffled set):

| model   |   median_attribution_purity |   median_pathway_input_fraction |   median_attribution_enrichment |   median_ablation_ratio |   median_other_ifn_attribution_share |
|:--------|----------------------------:|--------------------------------:|--------------------------------:|------------------------:|-------------------------------------:|
| D       |                       0.372 |                           0.038 |                          10.498 |                  30.058 |                                0.062 |
| D2      |                       0.375 |                           0.035 |                          10.910 |                  31.016 |                                0.066 |
| E       |                       0.246 |                           0.038 |                           7.198 |                  11.435 |                                0.130 |

Faithfulness Spearman, distribution over pathways. D and D2: latent vs the average of the unit's OWN genes. E (as stored by 05): latent vs the ORIGINAL biological pathway average, not E's own shuffled set:

| model   |   median |    min |   max |
|:--------|---------:|-------:|------:|
| D       |    0.672 | -0.177 | 0.929 |
| D2      |    0.670 | -0.187 | 0.964 |
| E       |    0.201 | -0.300 | 0.652 |

Like-for-like shuffled control (post-hoc correction after the 2026-10-11 audit, src/19): E vs the average of its OWN shuffled member genes:

| model                        |   n_pathways |   median_over_pathways |    min |   max |
|:-----------------------------|-------------:|-----------------------:|-------:|------:|
| D (own = real set)           |           47 |                  0.673 | -0.178 | 0.929 |
| E vs its own shuffled set    |           47 |                  0.455 |  0.107 | 0.589 |
| E vs original biological set |           47 |                  0.201 | -0.300 | 0.652 |

E keeps every pathway size and the full pairwise-overlap topology of the real mask; only gene identities are randomised. Units anchor to their own (even random) genes through the reconstruction objective, so the informative quantity is the D-vs-E(own) margin, not D vs E(original).

Faithfulness warnings (model D, median ablation ratio <= 1): none

## Overlap-aware model D2 vs D (internal, descriptive; not evidence for H5)

Kang contains only IFN-beta, so nothing here can show that D2 improves type-I vs type-II interferon specificity. That claim is reserved for the pre-specified external test (decision D14).
